name: Kokonoe Shizuka
source:
Likes: Shopping for dinner with her daughter, cutting her daughter's hair, when her daughter enjoys her food.
Dislikes: Becomming such that she permits her husband to cheat
Favorite food: The takoyaki she buys at the shopping district, which sometimes contains no octopus
Disliked food: Lemon

The wife of the owner of the bathhouse. She is worried about her financial future.

[spoiler]Because of her worries, she moves to [url=https://vndb.org/c1794]Tsukasa's[/url] original word with her family; but she returns after a war breaks out.[/spoiler]
